data.title: 史黛菈 · 露天温泉的绯红水汽
data.description: 深山温泉旅馆的私人露天浴池，周围枫叶如火。史黛菈浸泡在腾起白茫茫水汽的温泉水中，湿透的深红秀发贴在光洁玉背与丰满胸口前。水波泛着微光，热气将她雪白的肌肤蒸得如晚霞般绯红娇艳。她单手掬起一捧温水，转头看向岸边，眼神中透着皇女特有的骄傲与极尽深情。
data.location: secluded private outdoor hot spring bath surrounded by rocks
data.action: 在温泉水汽中倚着青石，深红秀发贴在肩胸，回眸凝望爱人
data.lighting: dappled sunlight through red autumn leaves hitting steamy water surface
data.promptProse: Soaking nude inside a secluded mountain hot spring framed by fiery red autumn maples, Stella leans near the mossy pool rocks as damp crimson strands cling to her bare shoulders and chest. Scooping a handful of warm spring water while turning toward the shore, she gazes back with a proud yet deeply affectionate blush. Dappled afternoon sunlight filters through the scarlet maple leaves and sparkles over the rising steam.
data.animaCaption: Soaking nude in a maple-ringed mountain hot spring, Stella scoops warm water in one hand and glances back over her flushed bare shoulder with proud affection. Dappled afternoon sunlight glints through crimson autumn leaves and rising steam.
data.nsfwProse: She soaks nude in the steaming outdoor stone hot spring, warm misty water veiling her lower body while her flushed bare shoulders, back, and collarbone glisten above the surface.
